name: zainhill
description: Zain Hill's agent skills, packaged as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: dojo
plugins.description: Odin-Project-style learning courses for technical topics: curated free resources, projects, retrieval practice, and a coach that never gives the answer.

plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: A senior developer for a junior: a code review that flags bugs, hand-rolled code and antipatterns, and a coach for any error or bug, both of which make you find each fix yourself.

plugins.name: lingo
plugins.description: Odin-Project-style courses for learning a language: CEFR placement per skill, curated free input, Anki-ready words, communicative tasks, a conversation partner that makes you repair your own errors, and writing feedback that never gives the fix.
